newsitem.title: UK: Virgin plans new Edinburgh rail sales centre.
newsitem.headline: Virgin plans new Edinburgh rail sales centre.

text.p: Virgin Group and its rail service partner Serco Group Plc are to set up a new rail customer service and telesales centre in Edinburgh, Scottish Secretary Michael Forsyth said on Tuesday.
He said the centre is expected initially to employ 250 people, but this could rise to 600 workers over the next five years.
Virgin has recently been awarded franchises to operate Britain's Intercity West Coast line and the CrossCountry Trains service.

Virgin chairman Richard Branson said: "The centre goes beyond traditional telesales operations and offers the public a one-stop shop' reflecting Virgin's commitment to enhance rail passenger customer service over the next 15 years."
"This is the first stage in our one billion stg investment programme in which Scotland will play a leading part," he added. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
